Cell.title: Cell
Cell.description:
One row: an input (no ``expr``) or a formula over the rows above. A fact that isn't a number
has ``text`` and no ``value``.

Check.title: Check
Check.description: Why a finding was raised: its sheet, the requirements, and what would change the result.

CheckedDesign.title: CheckedDesign
CheckedDesign.description: A valid design, both ways: the JSON document the forms edit and the YAML the tab shows.

DesignInput.title: DesignInput
DesignInput.description: A design to save: as YAML (the file, or the YAML tab) or as a JSON document (the forms).

FaceProfile.title: FaceProfile
FaceProfile.description: Where a face's cells sit, for the Parquet file and the heatmap.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description:
Something the builder must know: a limit exceeded, an assumption, a safety note. A warning
or an error carries the check that raised it: its formulas, inputs and sources (ADR 0013).

FiringPoint.title: FiringPoint
FiringPoint.description: The firing at one moment. Powers are averages over the step before it, in kW.

FiringResult.title: FiringResult
FiringResult.description: The summary of one simulated firing, with its working.

Lever.title: Lever
Lever.description: The input the builder controls, and the range (SI) to look for a change of state in.

Library.title: Library
Library.description:
What a design can choose from: materials, element alloys, cones, burners and what a
castable can be mixed from.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: A run of steel the frame needs: what it is, how many and how long.

MixAnalysis.title: MixAnalysis
MixAnalysis.description: A mix worked out: per batch, as cast, dried and fired.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: One reason a design is not valid, with where it is in the document.

Simulation.title: Simulation
Simulation.description: A simulated firing's status. When done, its results are under /simulations/{key}/…

SwitchOverChart.title: SwitchOverChart
SwitchOverChart.description: A hybrid's firing time and cost against where it hands over from elements to burners.

Template.title: Template
Template.description: A kind of kiln to start a design from.

WallHeatmap.title: WallHeatmap
WallHeatmap.description: Each face's temperatures through time: temperatures[t][face][node], °C.
